reconstructed_theorem_text: Let Ω and E be measurable spaces and μ a probability measure on Ω. Let X:ℝ×Ω→E have measurable slices X_t, let g:E→ℝ be measurable, and let A:ℝ×E→ℝ have measurable state slices A(v,·). Fix real endpoints a,b. Assume g(X_a) and g(X_b) are μ-integrable. Assume (v,ω)↦A(v,X(v,ω)) is integrable for (Lebesgue restricted to (min(a,b),max(a,b)])⊗μ. Let Z:Ω→ℝ be μ-integrable with ∫ Z dμ=0, and suppose μ-almost surely g(X(b,ω))−g(X(a,ω))=∫_a^b A(v,X(v,ω))dv+Z(ω). Write ν_t=(X_t)_#μ. Then ∫_E g dν_b−∫_E g dν_a=∫_a^b (∫_E A(v,x)dν_v(x))dv.
objects: Measurable sample and state spaces, μ, time-indexed state process, observable g, drift A, real endpoints, centered residual Z, and the three pushforward occurrences.
domains: All time indices and endpoints are real. State integrals are over E. The path drift integrability uses the time-first product of Lebesgue measure restricted to Set.uIoc(a,b)=(min(a,b),max(a,b)] and μ.
quantifiers: For each time t, X_t is measurable and for each v the state slice A(v,·) is measurable. The displayed real a,b are arbitrary. The increment identity is μ-a.e. in ω for the chosen a,b,Z.
assumptions: Slice measurability, measurability of g, the two endpoint integrabilities, the stated restricted-product integrability, integrable mean-zero Z, and the almost-sure balance. No order or nonnegativity condition is imposed on a,b.
conclusion: ∫_E g dν_b−∫_E g dν_a=∫_a^b (∫_E A(v,x)dν_v(x))dv, where ν_t=(X_t)_#μ. The compiled map arguments in order are X_b, X_a and X_v.
scopes: The interval integral is oriented: it changes sign on reversing endpoints and vanishes when the endpoints coincide. The product integrability condition uses the unordered half-open interval. Lean measure integrals use its totalized Bochner convention. The two g-integrals use the pushforward at b and at a, in that order. The drift integral at time v uses the pushforward at v. The compiler excerpts show a.e. measurability of each of these exact slice maps for the underlying measure of μ.
constant_dependencies: The residual enters with coefficient one and has zero mean. The sign of the time integral is determined by the endpoint order.
